name: fstatat
synopsis: int fstatat(int dirfd, const char *restrict pathname, struct stat *restrict statbuf, int flags);
description: The fstatat() system call retrieves file status information for a specified path, which can be relative to a given directory file descriptor. It provides a flexible interface similar to stat(), lstat(), and fstat(), with options to control behavior via flags.

parameters.name: dirfd
parameters.description: Directory file descriptor, or AT_FDCWD for current working directory

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Path to the file or symbolic link

parameters.name: statbuf
parameters.description: Pointer to a stat structure to store file information

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to modify behavior, such as AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Search permission is denied for one of the directories in the path prefix of pathname
dirfd is not a valid file descriptor, or pathname is relative and dirfd is neither AT_FDCWD nor valid
Too many symbolic links encountered while traversing the path
A component of pathname does not exist or is a dangling symbolic link, or pathname is an empty string and AT_EMPTY_PATH was not specified
A component of the path prefix of pathname is not a directory, or pathname is relative and dirfd refers to a non-directory
File size, inode number, or number of blocks cannot be represented in the appropriate types
